# ARTS

> pyarts is the Python interface for the
> Atmospheric Radiative Transfer Simulator
> (ARTS). It provides an interactive interface to the ARTS engine for running radiative transfer simulations.
> This is the documentation for ARTS version 3.0.0dev9. Other versions, scientific publications, and related tools
> are available on the ARTS website.
